discourse-affiliate.assessment: Native cooked and localized cooked processing. Shared post content and site setting adapters are required.

discourse-apple-auth.assessment: Native authentication middleware and callbacks. Shared provider discovery, initiation, status and site setting adapters are required.

discourse-details.assessment: Native details markup and rendering. Shared post content and site setting adapters are required.

discourse-graphviz.assessment: Native diagram markup and renderer. Shared post content and site setting adapters are required.

discourse-lazy-videos.assessment: Native video placeholders and player metadata. Shared post content and site setting adapters are required.

discourse-local-dates.assessment: Native date markup, localized display and calendar export behavior. Shared post content, useful structured dates and settings require verification.

discourse-login-with-amazon.assessment: Native provider middleware and callbacks. Shared provider discovery, initiation, status and settings are required.

discourse-lti.assessment: Native signed launch and authentication events remain authoritative. Shared provider and configuration adapters must preserve resulting role or group behavior.

discourse-math.assessment: Native mathematical markup and rendering. Shared post content and site setting adapters are required.

discourse-microsoft-auth.assessment: Native provider middleware and callbacks. Shared provider discovery, initiation, status and settings are required.

discourse-oauth2-basic.assessment: Native provider middleware and callbacks. Shared provider discovery, initiation, status and settings are required.

discourse-openid-connect.assessment: Native login and logout protocols remain authoritative. Shared provider discovery, initiation, status and settings must preserve both flows.

discourse-presence.assessment: Uses core presence operations with plugin registered channel permission logic. GraphQL presence writes and protected live delivery remain required.

footnote.assessment: Native footnote markup and display. Shared post content and site setting adapters are required.

spoiler-alert.assessment: Native spoiler markup and display. Shared post content and site setting adapters are required.

styleguide.assessment: The native controller serves the application shell for developer component demonstrations. It exposes no separate community data API. Preserve native group restrictions and site capability metadata through shared adapters.
